Account background: Saltmark is a global payments & risk platform (large broker/dealer and merchant acquiring clients). Long-time Redwood hosted API customer since 2024; currently on pay-as-you-go for embeddings and chat. Primary driver for expansion: deterministic latency and throughput for real-time fraud scoring; regulatory push for EU data residency in Q3.

- Renewal window: June 2026 (annual hosted contract) but customer wants to shift part of workload to Dedicated before renewal to lock pricing and SLA.
- Sales ask: Dedicated pools for fraud + embeddings, Optimize for batching/caching to cut token spend ~30-40%, Private/VPC in eu-west for EU residency.
- ARR opp: $400k-$1M depending on node sizing + Optimize seats.

Technical notes / requirements:

- Routing: want policy to route fraud to Dedicated (low latency), fallback to hosted smaller model if Dedicated capacity saturated.
